notes: Basement (UCLA floor B). Low-resolution building-automation screenshot (925 px wide, about 9 cm/px). All room numbers typed by hand from the plan; zone colours not kept.

Hand cuts at partitions the screenshot draws too thin (B222/B200CO, B225A/B227, B229/B233, B243/B330, B306/B306B, B125/B125B and the B208 lobby).
The OCR reads the B prefix as 8 in a few rooms; those pieces are relabeled by hand (set).
